title: Secoda Permission and Role Change Audit
app: Secoda audit and usage events via the Secoda API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=secoda:audit (action="*permission*" OR action="*owner*" OR action="*group*")
| stats count as changes, values(action) as actions by user_name
| sort - changes
description: Audits Secoda events that grant, revoke or modify permissions and roles, giving a change trail for least-privilege reviews and incident investigation.
value: Unreviewed permission changes are a leading cause of data-access incidents; an audit trail for Secoda supports governance and rollback.
implementation: Ingest Secoda admin/audit events; schedule daily and alert on privilege grants made outside an approved change window.
visualization: Table of actor by change count with actions, timeline.
grandmaExplanation: We keep a record of who changes access and permissions in Secoda so unexpected changes can be traced.
